facility.name: Child of Mine Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3221 N 38TH ST, MCALLEN, TX, 78501

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A 3 year old child was left unsupervised in the restroom.     CORRECTED: Director approached the restroom area to assist child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: A health statement was not submitted within the 12 months of enrolement date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: Parental notice of lack of liability insuranced form was not avilable for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §746.207(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: Lesson plan for the week was not available for review nor posted. Infant daily schedule does reflect an AM opportunity for outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: Operational policies were reviewed and the following information is missing:    (1) Hours / Days of Operation  (18)(f) Outdoor Activity - Extreme weather criteria   (30) Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Four out of four children's records reviewed are missing the updated special care statement. One file is missing health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was providing care for 6 children ages 13mo-22mo, SAG 12-17mo. Classroom was over ratio by one child.     Note: during inspection one of the children was transfered to another classroom placing room back within ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Trash can by the diaper changing station does not have a lid and was observed with used diapers.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when trash can was emptied and trash can was replaced with one with a lid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: Changing mat in the infant room is torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Last fire drill conducted on 02/08/2023 was completed in four minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: There are cleaning products accessible to children in the cabinet underneath the boy's sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: Food Allergy information for two children is not posted in the kitchen and information for one child is not posted in the child's classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: One caregiver was caring for four children ages 3mo to 4yo in the multipurpose room. One caregiver was caring for 8 children ages 16mo to 3yo in the prek room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: One of the infants room was changed into a toddler classroom.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when operation provided an updated floor plan and agreed to update infant's capacity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: Lesson plan posted in the prek room did not match planned activities for the week and was dated June Week 1. This week's written lesson plans for infant-age children was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: One out of four children's records reviewed is missing a food allergy plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Toddler-age children were not served a vegetable portion during lunch and Infant-age children were not fed a meat (or alternative) protein portion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: Two out of four staff files reviewed are missing four hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: Menu posted did not match items served during lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One qualified caregiver and an employee of the operation were caring for 6 children ages 6mo-12mo, SAG 0-11momo. Classroom was over ratio by two children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: Emergency Preparedness Plan was reviewed and missing the following:    -Staff responsibilities  -how will children with disabilities and under 2yo will be evacuated  -how will attendance will be checked,  -how will operation communicate with local authorities   -how will staff evacuate and relocated essential information  -how will staff care for children until they are released   -how will children be reunify with parents
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: Operation does not have a carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: Operation does not have a smoke detecting system.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §746.5311(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There was a plastic tub with water in the playground. There were two disinfecting spray cans in the girl's restroom, one by the sink and the second underneath the sink. There were two hand sanitizer bottles and a disinfecting spray can underneath the sink of the infant's room. The cabinets were not locked.     Note: This was corrected when cleaning products were removed and/or placed in locked cabinet and water from plastic tub was dumped.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Play-yards in the infant room are not labeled with the children's name or assigned number.    This was correct at inspection when provider labeled with play-yards with the children's names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Three infant bottles observed during inspection were not labeled with the children's name.     This was corrected at inspection when provider labeled the bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Two out of five children's files reviewed were not available at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One of our two staff files reviewed is missing a notarized affidavit. A second files is missing copy of high school diploma or ged, notarized affidavit, orientation statement and 8hr of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
